tokens.name: page-bg
tokens.usage: Page ground, as rendered behind the page's content (the body gradient, averaged). Every text pairing below is checked against it.

tokens.name: page-text
tokens.usage: Default body text on `page-bg`: the colour most of the page's text uses that reads on it (5.3:1).

tokens.name: page-surface
tokens.usage: Surface most of the page's running text sits on (cards, panels).

tokens.name: color-gold
tokens.usage: Luxury, prosperity, elegance. Used as text on `nav a`, `.stat-label`, `.card-title`. 9.4:1 on `page-bg`.

tokens.name: color-black
tokens.usage: Sophistication, drama, contrast. Used as text on `.card-badge`, `.button-primary`, `thead`. 1.0:1 on `page-bg` — under 3:1 here, as in the source: use it only on the lighter or darker fills the reference page pairs it with, never as text on `page-bg`.

tokens.name: color-emerald
tokens.usage: Jewel-tone richness, vitality. Used as text on `.stat-change`. 9.3:1 on `page-bg`.

tokens.name: color-cream
tokens.usage: Refined warmth, champagne. Used as text on `body`, `nav a:hover`, `.stat-value`. 17.9:1 on `page-bg`.

tokens.name: color-success
tokens.usage: Success state; pair with a label or icon.

tokens.name: color-warning
tokens.usage: Warning state; pair with a label or icon.

tokens.name: color-error
tokens.usage: Error / danger state; pair with a label or icon.

tokens.name: card-bg
